inject.description: Inject and run one chromatogram (~10 min). Result is a peak list [{rt_min, area}]; peaks are unnamed, use standards for identification and quantitation
Inject the sample vial placed on the instrument (dilute polymer with THF to ~1–5 mg/mL first); after ~25 min returns Mn, Mw, PDI (relative to polystyrene standards) and the chromatogram

acquire.description: Inject and acquire an ESI+ mass spectrum. Result is [{mz, intensity}] ([M+H]+, relative intensity)

inject.description: Inject (~15 min). Detects only volatile molecules (with boiling-point data, bp < 350 °C); result is [{rt_min, area}]

set_temperature.description: Set hold temperature (sealed vial, may exceed atmospheric boiling point; refused if predicted pressure exceeds 85% of the limit)

set_hold.description: Set hold time (timer starts once the set temperature is reached)

start.description: Seal and run the program (heat → hold → cool to 55 °C and unlock); fill volume 2 mL to 2/3 of vial volume

stop.description: End the hold early and start cooling

read.description: Read all wells in the instrument (~15 s); result plate = [{well, A}] (includes plate background, subtract blank wells)

acquire.description: Acquire a 1H spectrum (~5 min). Result is a peak list [{shift_ppm, integral, mult}]; integrals normalized as number of 1H × mole fraction; peaks are unassigned
Scan the dry powder on the sample stage (~20 min); peaks (2θ, relative intensity, phase) are given only for phases with reference patterns, the rest are listed in no_reference

measure.description: Measure melting range (capillary sample). Result is [onset, clear point] °C

profiles.model: self-built DIY foam rig (cylinder + air pump + webcam)

sparge.description: Sparge foaming: gas at flow_mL_min for duration_s seconds (sintered glass / air stone)

stir.description: Stir foaming: stir at speed_rpm for duration_s seconds (only on models that support stirring)

measure.description: Take one shot: side-view foam height / liquid height, top-view mean bubble radius and area fraction of large bubbles (R > 0.5 mm)

record.description: Record continuously for duration_s seconds (one shot every interval_s seconds); at the end reports initial height and half-life (extrapolated from the decay shape if it has not dropped to half)

drain.description: Drain the foam column (liquid goes to the internal waste bottle)

rinse.description: Rinse the foam column with water `cycles` times

set_temperature.description: Prepare coolant: uses the closest recipe (0 / −15 / −40 / −78 / −196 °C)

read.description: Read the collected gas volume (the tube must first be connected to the reaction vessel with attach_probe: device=gas_1, port=in)

start.description: Start rotary evaporation: set bath temperature and vacuum; liquids that boil at that pressure (organic solvents, water, volatile reagents) are evaporated in turn, stops automatically when done

set_wavelengths.description: Set excitation/emission wavelengths; place a cuvette on fluor_1 to read intensity

set_temperature.description: Set heating target temperature. Controls on liquid temperature when the PT1000 probe is inserted, otherwise on plate temperature.
Set bath temperature (-20 to 95 °C, water/ethylene glycol bath fluid)

stop.description: Stop temperature control (bath returns to room temperature on its own)

stir.description: Stir foaming: stir at speed_rpm for duration_s seconds (only on models that support stirring)

drain.description: Drain the foam column (liquid goes to the internal waste bottle)

rinse.description: Rinse the foam column with water `cycles` times

measure.description: Measure the Z-average size (nm) and polydispersity index PDI of particles in the cuvette on the instrument (~2 min)

start.description: Start electrolysis (electrodes must first be inserted into the cell with attach_probe: device=pstat_1, port=cell)

run_cv.description: Cyclic voltammetry (cell port connected to the cell, three electrodes: 3 mm glassy carbon working electrode, Ag/AgCl reference): sweep from start to vertex and back. Result cv = {scan_rate_mV_s, peaks:[{Epc_V, Epa_V, ipc_uA, ipa_uA}]} (potentials vs Ag/AgCl)

read.description: Read current pH (the reading updates continuously; this command only forces a recorded reading)
Read current conductivity (the reading updates continuously)

start.description: Start heating and hold (runs until stop; write wait_done = false in the plan)

stop.description: Stop heating (furnace cools naturally, ~1 h time constant; take samples only below 100 °C)

dispense.description: Refill as needed + dispense: if the syringe holds too little, switch the valve to in and draw the shortfall, then switch back to out and push volume at rate

infuse.description: Push only the liquid already in the syringe to the out port; alarms and stops when empty

withdraw.description: Withdraw into the syringe from port (in or out, default out)

refill.description: Switch the valve to in, fill the syringe (or draw volume), then switch back to out

pause.description: Pause the current action (keeps the remaining volume)

stop.description: Stop and discard the remaining action

set_speed.description: Shake at rpm (latch must be closed; no pipetting while shaking)

close_latch.description: Close the labware latch (required before shaking and pipetting)

transfer.description: With a fresh tip, aspirate volume_uL from src and dispense into dst (pipette chosen automatically, split if over capacity; viscous liquids automatically use slow aspirate/dispense with 30 s waits). src/dst must be on the OT-2 deck or a deck module

mix.description: With a fresh tip, mix in the container by aspirate/dispense `cycles` times (inefficient for viscous liquids; Heater-Shaker recommended)

deposit_droplets.description: Aspirate from src and place one drop on each unused spot of the contact-angle stage (default 3 × 3 µL)

image_droplets.description: Pick up the camera and image the side of the last n unimaged droplets (wait wait_s after dispensing before imaging; if contour detection fails, wait 5 s more and retake once); results appear in the contact-angle stage readings

measure_viscosity.description: Proxy viscosity measurement: a standard 1000 µL tip aspirates 10×rate µL from src at 100 µL/s, waits 30 s, touches the wall three times, dispenses onto the balance dish at rate_uL_s for 10 s (balance read every 0.2 s), waits 30 s. Results appear in the viscometer readings

profiles.model: Mettler Toledo / custom MS303TS + dispense dish (OT-2 proxy viscometer)

fit_power_law.description: Jointly fit a power-law + air-cushion model to all valid dispense curves of the latest sample (at least two flow rates) to get K, n and the viscosity at the reference shear rate

seal.description: Close and tighten the vessel head (headspace is 1 atm air); fill no more than 80 % of vessel volume

purge.description: Gas purge: pressurize to pressure (bar), vent to 1 atm, repeat `cycles` times (purge O2 with N2 before hydrogenation)

charge.description: Charge gas from the cylinder to total pressure (bar); with hold = 1 the regulator holds constant pressure and records gas consumption gas_uptake

close_supply.description: Close the gas supply (stop constant-pressure feed)

vent.description: Vent and open the vessel head (dissolved gas escapes); cool below 50 °C first

measure.description: Extrude a pendant drop from the sample cell on the instrument, wait drop_age_s, then image and fit the surface tension; repeat for `replicates` drops (low-concentration surfactants need longer drop age to equilibrate)

profiles.model: custom Staircase stage + pick-up USB camera (RAISE-style)

read.description: Read the latest imaging result (imaging is triggered by OT-2 image_droplets)

run.description: Heat in air from 25 °C to T_end (°C) at rate (°C/min); result curve = [{T, mass_pct}] (one point every 25 °C)

dispense.description: Refill as needed + dispense: if the syringe holds too little, automatically switch the valve to in and draw the shortfall, then switch back to out and push volume at rate

infuse.description: Push only the liquid already in the syringe to the out port; alarms and stops when empty

withdraw.description: Withdraw into the syringe from port (in or out, default out)

refill.description: Switch the valve to in, fill the syringe (or draw volume), then switch back to out

pause.description: Pause the current action (keeps the remaining volume)

stop.description: Stop and discard the remaining action

blank.description: Zero on the cuvette currently in the sample compartment (usually filled with solvent)

measure.description: Read current absorbance (the reading updates continuously; this command only forces a refresh)

profiles.model: Thermo Fisher Nicolet iS5 + iD7 ATR

acquire.description: Acquire an ATR IR spectrum (~1 min): put the sample in an ir_card (or small vial) on ftir_1. Result is a peak list [{wavenumber, absorbance, assign_hint}]

profiles.model: Vapourtec R-Series (R2+ pump module / R4 reactor module)

set_flow.description: Set feed flow rates (mL/min); feed_a / feed_b mix at the coil inlet, feed_c (optional) is added at the coil midpoint (between the two sections)

set_temperature.description: Set coil temperature; temperature_2 (optional) is the temperature of the second section (after the midpoint)

set_uv_wavelength.description: Set the detection wavelength of the outlet inline UV flow cell (2 mm path, before the back-pressure regulator)

collect_start.description: Switch the outlet to the collection vessel (port out)

collect_stop.description: Switch the outlet back to waste

place_container.description: Place a container on a slot or device (location is a slot id, device id or storage)

move_plate.description: Move a whole plate (all wells at src) to dst (slot, plate reader, liquid-handling station or storage)

add_stir_bar.description: Put a stir bar into a container

attach_probe.description: Insert a device probe (e.g. ph_1.probe, stirrer_1.pt1000) into a container

connect_tube.description: Connect a pump's in/out tubing to containers

transfer_liquid.description: Measure and transfer liquid manually (pipette/graduated cylinder); volume error depends on the executor

dry_glassware.description: Dry empty glassware with an oven / heat gun and cool it under dry conditions (removes adsorbed surface water; required before moisture-sensitive reactions)

syringe_transfer.description: Transfer liquid by syringe / cannula under inert atmosphere without air contact (both ends must be purged first, or be a sealed inert reagent bottle)

service_device.description: Device maintenance: replace tip racks (replace_tip_rack_p20/p300/p1000), replace contact-angle substrate (replace_substrate), empty the viscometer dish (empty_dish), etc.; needs a human or robot arm

transfer_solid.description: Weigh solid by difference on an analytical balance from a solid reagent bottle (mass, g) into dst; reports the balance reading

dilute_to_mark.description: Add deionized water to a volumetric flask up to the mark and mix

filter.description: Suction filtration: precipitate collects on filter (crucible), filtrate goes to dst; wash=true (default) washes the precipitate with deionized water; rinse_vessel=true repeatedly rinses the source vessel for quantitative transfer (slower, recovery near 100%)

dry.description: Dry in an oven to constant weight, then cool in a desiccator (mostly waiting time)

observe.description: Visually observe the solution color and whether there is a precipitate (subjective, qualitative)

column_chromatography.description: Flash column chromatography (simplified model): load all of src, collect fractions with Rf close to the target (target, molecule name) by Rf, concentrate to a residue in dst; target recovery about 90%

read_volume.description: Read the liquid volume in a graduated cylinder/graduated vessel (manual reading, about ±0.3 mL)

attach_distillation.description: Attach a distillation head + straight condenser, distillate flows into receiver (heating to boiling then starts distillation)

recrystallize.description: Recrystallization: dissolve the crude solid in src in minimal hot solvent, cool to crystallize, filter and dry, collect crystals in dst (main product recovery ~85%, most impurities stay in the mother liquor)

tlc.description: Spot, develop and view the TLC plate under UV: returns the Rf of each spot (only molecules with Rf data appear)

attach_gas_balloon.description: Evacuate/backfill and attach a balloon (e.g. H2): the reaction stays saturated with that gas at 1 atm and sealed from air

purge_inert.description: Purge with nitrogen/argon and keep an inert atmosphere (removes dissolved oxygen; required before air-sensitive reactions)

open_to_air.description: Remove the inert atmosphere and expose to air

attach_condenser.description: Attach a reflux condenser to the flask (then it can be heated to reflux without solvent loss)

separate_phases.description: Separatory funnel separation: aqueous phase to aq_dst, organic phase to org_dst (transferring after adding organic solvent counts as thorough shaking to partition equilibrium)
